clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirements of ribbed screen, plain screen and plain casing pipes of nominal diameter 40  to 400 mm produced from unplasticized polyvinyl chloride for bore/tubewell for water supply.

clauses.title: Composition
clauses.text: 2. Composition —  The pipe shall  be produced from material consisting substantially polyvinyl chloride conforming to IS 10151 : 1982*  which may be added only those additives as are needed to facilitate manufacture of sound pipe with good surface finish, mechanical strength and opacity under conditions of use.

clauses.title: Colour
clauses.text: 3. Colour —  Shall be of regular blue colour throughout. Slight colour deviation is permissible.

clauses.title: Designation
clauses.text: 4. Designation — Pipe shall be designated by its type whether ribbed screen (RS), plain screen (PS) or casing (CS or CM) followed by its nominal diameter DN, slot width and length of the pipe. Example — Ribbed Screen pipe of DN 200 with slot width 1.5 mm and length 2000 mm shall be designated as  RS 200 × 1.5 × 2000.

clauses.title: Threading of Screen and
clauses.text: 6. Threading of Screen and Casing Pipes -The screen and casing pipe shall have male threads at spigot end and female threads at the socket end.  Screen and casing pipe of nominal diameter from 40 to 80 mm shall have threads in accordance with  IS  554 : 1985*. Screen and casing pipes of nominal diameters of 100 to 400 mm shall have threads in accordance with basic profile for metric trapezoidal threads. Rubber element should  be used with the trapezoidal threads shall be of shore hardnes 165±5

clauses.title: Tests
clauses.text: 7. Tests

clauses.title: Visual Appearance
clauses.text: 7.1 Visual Appearance —The internal and external surfaces of each pipe shall be smooth, clean and free from any defects.  The ends shall be clean and square with the axis of the pipe.

clauses.title: Internal Dia
clauses.text: 7.2 Internal Dia —Test mandrel of diameter as specified below of 100 mm length shall pass smoothly through the pipe.

clauses.title: Specific gravity
clauses.text: 7.3 Specific gravity — Between 1.4 to 1.45 g/cm3

clauses.title: Impact Strength at OoC
clauses.text: 7.4 Impact Strength at OoC —   Shall not fracture or crack through its complete wall thickness.

clauses.title: Tensile Strength
clauses.text: 7.5 Tensile Strength— Shall not be less than  45 MPa.

clauses.title: Vicat Softening Temperatue
clauses.text: 7.6 Vicat Softening Temperatue— Not less than 76 o C.
